### Overview


Real-Time Localization for Global Pega Applications Organizations expanding their Pega applications across multiple regions often face challenges in managing application localization. Traditional localization processes involve manual translation activities, file exports, resource updates, validation cycles, and coordination among multiple teams, resulting in increased effort and longer release timelines. fxTranslate addresses these challenges by enabling real-time, inline localization directly within the Pega Constellation Application. The solution allows users to translate application content within their existing workflow while pushing the localization into Pega directly, or generating localized JSON files, reducing manual effort and improving translation consistency. This approach accelerates multilingual application deployment and simplifies global application releases.


### Key Features


- Real-time inline translation within Pega
- Automated localization generation
- Faster multilingual application deployment
- Improved consistency across global releases
- Enhanced productivity for developers and business analysts
